title: The Lantern Moth
statement: Long ago, when the night sky was still unfinished, a small moth mistook the first star for a lantern left on for her and spent a thousand years flying toward it, mending every dark patch she crossed with the dust from her wings. When she finally arrived, the lantern turned out to be only a star, so she stayed beside it anyway, and now on clear nights her seven stars flutter open and shut as if still curious.
